text: WHEN an entry has header immediately followed by ***CORE*** marker THEN that entry is included in IDENTITY_CORE_IMMEDIATE.md
WHEN an entry has no ***CORE*** marker THEN it is excluded from IDENTITY_CORE_IMMEDIATE.md
WHEN THOOR.md is parsed THEN exactly 5 named entries by exact title match are included in original file order
WHEN a required THOOR.md entry is not found THEN compilation fails with a clear error
WHEN compiler runs successfully THEN it atomically writes IDENTITY_CORE_IMMEDIATE.md then CORE_IDENTITY.md then a manifest
WHEN compileProjection is invoked THEN it computes current hashes and compares against manifest; if any differ or manifest missing THEN synchronously recompile
WHEN compileProjection returns THEN the returned projection is verbatim content of CORE_IDENTITY.md
WHEN any of the five source files is missing or unreadable THEN the compiler fails closed with a clear error
WHEN AnimaProjectionCompiler.compile() is invoked from any other code path THEN its behavior is completely unchanged
WHEN the compiler writes its manifest THEN it contains individual hashes for SOUL KERNEL JUDGMENTS THOOR SCARS plus immediateHash coreHash builtAt compilerVersion
WHEN a file-watcher detects a change THEN it debounces and triggers an atomic recompile and never watches identityCache/ itself
WHEN compileProjection returns RuntimeProjection for the static path THEN prompt equals CORE_IDENTITY.md verbatim and all scope fields are defaults
